definitions.explanation: A condition in which blood pressure is lower than normal, often causing symptoms like dizziness or fatigue.

examples.japanese: {低血圧|ていけつあつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I have trouble with mornings because of low blood pressure.

examples.japanese: {低血圧|ていけつあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧めまい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低血圧|ていけつあつ}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ふらふらする→ふらふらする：21629_furafurasuru⟧。

examples.english: People with low blood pressure often have trouble getting up in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{低血圧|ていけつあつ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高血圧|こうけつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧ (high blood pressure, hypertension)

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧ (blood pressure)
- ⟦{血圧計|けつあつけい}→血圧計：15567_ketsuatsukei⟧ (blood pressure monitor)
- {起立性低血圧|きりつせいていけつあつ} (orthostatic hypotension)

SYMPTOMS:
- めまい (dizziness)
- ⟦{立|た}ちくらみ→立ちくらみ：14791_tachikurami⟧ (lightheadedness upon standing)
- {疲労感|ひろうかん} (fatigue)
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (difficulty waking up)

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, being {低血圧|ていけつあつ} is commonly given as an explanation for being sluggish in the morning or having difficulty waking up, though the medical connection is not strongly supported.
